data.description: Former monk and aide also ordered to return B300 million to Wat Phrabat Namphu

data.title: Ngern Tid Lor PLC Earns Recognition for Financial Education at ESGBusiness Awards 2026
data.description: Ngern Tid Lor Public Company Limited, a subsidiary of Tidlor Holdings (TIDLOR) , won the Social Inclusion and Equal Opportunities Award - Thailand at the ESGBusiness Awards 2026 . The award recognizes the organization's outstanding performance in driving equality and fostering social inclusion through the "Financial Knowledge to Communities for Life Rolls Forward" project, which has been operating continuously for over a decade. This reflects the company's intention to elevate people's quality of life through creating financial knowledge opportunities, aiming to promote sustainably better lives for people in society.

data.title: Myanmar leader lands in Malaysia for migrant return talks
data.description: KUALA LUMPUR - Myanmar's leader landed for his first visit to Malaysia on Wednesday, since taking power in a 2021 coup, as Kuala Lumpur seeks his cooperation to return thousands of migrants.

data.title: Bangkok Central Kitchen brings healthy meals to 1500 students
data.description: "Bangkok, City for Better Health" launched a "Central Kitchen" at Wat Don School, enabling the preparation of nutritious meals for almost 1,500 students across seven schools in the Sathon and Bang Rak districts.

data.title: US military face curfew, alcohol ban on Okinawa after murder case
data.description: TOKYO - US forces on Okinawa were on Wednesday barred from drinking alcohol for 48 hours and also face a 30-day curfew after the murder of a woman allegedly committed by an American Marine.

data.title: Mourning, war and elections as Israel marks Oct 7
data.description: RE'IM — Israel marked the third anniversary of Hamas's attack on Oct 7 on Wednesday with silent tributes, new strikes on Gaza and intense political debate, weeks before elections in which the country's deadliest day will be front and centre.

data.title: Anutin slams Prachin Buri district chief for mishandling flood
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has admonished Prachin Buri's Ban Sang district chief who was abruptly transferred on Wednesday after being accused of resisting cooperation and not making a sufficient effort to help flood victims in the province.

data.title: Verstappen revival to be put to the test in steamy Singapore
data.description: SINGAPORE - Max Verstappen's resurgence in Malaysia will be put to the test just 300 kilometres south at the Singapore Grand Prix this weekend, where the Red Bull driver may need to overcome the elements and his own poor record at the Marina Bay Street Circuit.

data.title: Western provinces warned of flooding, poor drainage in east
data.description: The government on Wednesday warned of possible flooding in western provinces with forecasts of heavy rain, while explaining high tides are impeding drainage of flood waters from eastern provinces Chachoengsao and Prachin Buri.

data.title: Filipino family crash into temple wall kills 3-year-old son
data.description: SURAT THANI — A three-year-old Filipino boy was killed and three other members of his family were injured after their Mitsubishi Pajero crashed into a temple wall in Ban Ta Khun district early Wednesday morning.

data.title: Aichi governor upset as Thai teqball team complain about food at Asian Games
data.description: Hideaki Ōmura, governor of Aichi Prefecture, has said he is displeased that Thailand's national teqball team posted complaints online about the small food portions at the 2026 Asian Games, suggesting they did it to attract views and that he would rather they did not return.

data.title: Armed robbers take nearly B30m from Chinese residents of Chon Buri mansion
data.description: CHON BURI: Three armed robbers held the Chinese occupants of a luxury residence at gunpoint before escaping with cash and assets worth a combined nearly 30 million baht on Tuesday.

data.title: Malaysia’s Myanmar bet? Repatriations pave way for diplomacy
data.description: BEIJING — Malaysia’s repatriation of Myanmar nationals ahead of a visit to Kuala Lumpur by the war-torn country’s leader appears to mirror efforts by other Southeast Asian countries seeking to mend ties with Nay Pyi Taw.

data.title: Messi signs off in tears after one last Argentina master class
data.description: BUENOS AIRES — Lionel ⁠Messi delivered one ⁠last master class in ​blue and white on Tuesday as Argentina's captain brought the curtain down on his extraordinary 21-year international career by ​scoring one goal and setting up two others ‌in a 3-0 friendly win over Benin.

data.title: Nobel Peace Prize haunted by the 'spectre' of Trump
data.description: OSLO - Donald Trump's chances of winning the Nobel Peace Prize are seen as minimal, but his "spectre" will cast its shadow over Friday's announcement of the winner in Oslo, experts say.

data.title: Sleep, appetite, gene-editing experts contend for Nobel chemistry prize
data.description: STOCKHOLM - Molecules that regulate sleep and appetite or methods for editing genes are some of the research fields commentators say could be contenders for the Nobel Prize in Chemistry announced on Wednesday.

data.title: Climate champion Australia digging more coal
data.description: SYDNEY - An export boom has prompted Australia's coal mines to expand despite the nation preparing to champion clean energy as lead negotiator for the UN's climate summit.

data.title: US woman who survived botched execution is conscious, speaking: lawyers
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The female inmate who survived a failed execution in a US prison last week is now conscious and speaking, but her prognosis remains unclear, her lawyers said Tuesday.

data.title: Heavy rain in Greater Bangkok from Saturday to Monday
data.description: The Meteorological Department expects heavy rain in Greater Bangkok from Saturday to Monday as the country is reaching the end of the wet season.

data.title: N. Korea's Kim pledges 'invariable support' in Putin birthday letter
data.description: SEOUL - North Korean leader Kim Jong Un pledged his "invariable support" for Russia in a birthday letter to President Vladimir Putin, while hailing Moscow's war in Ukraine as "sacred", state media reported Wednesday.

data.title: Kamin presents 14th Self-Enquiry show 'Mountain Is Mountain, River Is River'
data.description: Kamin Lertchaiprasert presents the 14th exhibition in his Self-Enquiry project, "Mountain Is Mountain, River Is River", which is running at 31st Century Museum of Contemporary Spirit in Chiang Mai until Dec 19.

data.title: It's all in the mind at Munins' 'Still On'
data.description: Thai artist Munins invites everyone to explore how the mind works through three essential processes during "Still On", which is running at RCB Galleria 5, 3rd floor of River City Bangkok, Charoen Krung 24, until Nov 15.
